title: 第3章 这就是职业足球第4章 急于表现
content_zh:
第三章 这就是职业足球
更衣室内，这个时间是用来做战前布置的，只不过今天胖子安切洛蒂并没有出现，他是拿过联赛冠军，欧冠冠军的名帅，这样计划外的热身赛自然用不着他大驾光临，身为名帅有的时候也要给其他人机会，比如他曾经的队友，现在的助手塔索蒂。
塔索蒂曾经米兰王朝的缔造者之一，AC米兰的功勋战将，他在足球场上威风八面，但是处在教练这个位子上，他的性格注定了他很难独当一面，只能作为一个辅助者存在，特里姆在位的时候，他就是助理教练，现在轮到安切洛蒂了，他还是助理教练，他的角色从来都没有改变过，迪甘还知道，后来的莱昂纳多，阿莱格里入主米兰之后，他还是这个角色。
不得不说，塔索蒂的战术安排简直无趣至极，听的让人昏昏欲睡，但是迪甘还是努力坚持着，让自己看上去聚精会神。
到了宣布首发名单的时候了，守门员是一线队的三号门将菲奥里，一个35岁的大叔，效力米兰已经有四年的时间了，不过四年当中，他只得到过一次机会，不过这位大叔也不是个省油的灯，至少他的头脑非常聪明，等到退役的时候，居然已经拿到了法学博士的学位。
后防线上四大金刚，迪甘占据了一席之地，其余三个人分别是左后卫潘卡罗，上个赛季就效力队中的意大利老将。
中后卫迪甘的搭档是阿根廷人，小狮王科洛奇尼，在外漂泊了两年的时间，总算是回到了队中，不过迪甘知道，这厮在AC米兰一样没能取得成功，半个赛季只出场了一次，而后便专会去了拉科鲁尼亚。
右后卫克罗地亚人西米奇，AC米兰阵中不可缺少的酱油男，每个赛季都嚷嚷着要么主力位置，要么离开，但是每个赛季开始之后，人们总能在替补席上找到他的影子。
中场菱形站位，拖后的是意大利老男孩儿多纳蒂，不过听说他已经要离开了，他的下一站将是梅西纳，过惯了漂泊的日子，多纳蒂对这一切似乎看得很开。
两大护法是达拉博纳和新赛季转会过来的法国人多拉苏，一个是被AC米兰坑了的悲剧男，一个是在吊丝俱乐部待腻了的法国天王。
突前负责组织进攻的是AC米兰的替补天王布罗基，这厮在AC米兰就没打出来过，可是一旦离开米兰内洛，租借到别的球队，总是能发挥出让人惊叹的实力，也是因为如此，AC米兰对他一直都难以割舍。
双前锋分别是意甲绿帽男博列洛和米兰青训出品，后来在卡利亚里羽化登仙的马特里。
迪甘很想对塔索蒂说，他想要打中锋的位置，但是昨天下了决定要做好孩子，今天就不听从教练战术安排的话，未免有点儿说不过去。
再说，迪甘相信自己是天才，中后卫又能怎么样，他觉得自己一样能完爆里米尼教练的神经，拿到一张通往职业足球的入场券。
只不过塔索蒂的战术安排，让迪甘有些不爽，防守反击，而起防守球员在运动战中，不能越过中线。
打里米尼这样的菜鸟球队，居然用得着防守反击，迪甘甚至觉得就依着塔索蒂这谨慎的性格，他站在场边的时候，都应该带着安全帽，因为没有人规定鸟在飞行的时候，不能下蛋。
不过现在迪甘什么都不能说，因为他要做好孩子，因为他要表现出他的职业素养，因为他的哥哥是卡卡，一个彬彬有礼的王子。
“罗德！有问题吗？”
迪甘一愣，他没想到塔索蒂会专门问到他，事实上刚才他什么都没听，这会儿被问道，他不禁有些尴尬：“不！教练！没~~~~~没有！”
迪甘手足无措的样子，引得更衣室内一阵笑声，潘卡罗作为首发名单里面最大牌的球员笑道：“罗德！冷静点儿！”

塔索蒂也笑道：“罗德！这只是一场热身赛，没什么大不了的！而且这还是你代表米兰的第一场比赛，只要发挥出你的实力！你能做得很好！”
塔索蒂的提醒，让博列洛等人看迪甘的眼神都变了，很显然他们在羡慕，作为效力米兰多年的球员，他们一直被租借在外，都在一边努力，一边等待机会，但是这么多年过去了，幸运之神，从来都没有降临在他们的头上，而迪甘一来，就受到了教练的重视，尽管他们都知道这是怎么回事儿，但是他们还是忍不住羡慕，甚至是嫉妒。
完成了战术布置之后，塔索蒂就站在了一旁，看着球员们更换装备，这只是一场热身赛，没有人会要求他们在什么时候出场。
迪甘也拿到了他的球衣82号，一个很不寻常的号码，说它不寻常，那是因为这个号码注定不会出现在新赛季AC米兰的一线队之中。
不过迪甘倒是没觉得怎么样，他前世是AC米兰的球迷，能穿着米兰的球衣比赛，这本身就是件很不寻常的事情了。
该出场了，迪甘感觉不到一丝紧张，有的只是兴奋，前世因为心脏病，他远离了心爱的足球，他的天赋只能用来和几个朋友踢踢野球，寻找一下快乐，现在一个强大的迪甘来了。
比赛是在米兰内洛进行的，能够前来观战的除了球员家属之外，只有三百名球迷会员，这种气氛给迪甘的感觉，就好像是足球游戏一样。
但是迪甘不敢放松，这是他的机会，如果不想新赛季只能在青年队里厮混的话，他就必须抓住，牢牢的抓住，然后用他的努力为自己争取一张通往职业联赛的入场券。
在观战的人群之中，迪甘还发现了他的父母，当然卡罗琳也来了，卡卡认识她的时候，迪甘就认识了，两个人虽然没能发展成情侣，但却是很要好的朋友。
站在大禁区前，看着裁判一声哨响，比赛开始，尽管只是二线队，但是很显然米兰的实力，依然不是里米尼能够抗衡的，比赛前十分钟，足球基本上都在里米尼的半场，迪甘想要捞到一个表现的机会都没有。
没关系，比赛的时间还有很长，他有的是机会表现。
或许是上天听到了他的祈祷，马特里射门，被里米尼的门将压在了身下，紧接着一个大脚，开到了米兰的半场，而且是直接朝着迪甘这个方向飞了过来。
按照一个后卫争取的处理方式，迪甘就应该找好足球的落点，然后倚住里米尼的前锋，将球顶回去。
但是迪甘不想这么做，那样的话，他根本就没机会展现自己的实力，前世作为一个边锋，他对足球落点的判断无疑是高人一等的，轻轻跃起，用胸部将球停住，然后~~~~~没有然后了。
迪甘忘记了他现在这个身体的速度，将球停的有些远，结果被里米尼的前锋抢先将球得到，一记斜传，足球到了米兰进去的左侧，潘卡罗一个失神，对方的另一名前锋接到了球，菲奥里只能弃门出击，结果对方球员非常冷静的一脚低射，洞穿了AC米兰的球门。
AC米兰率先失球了，到场的三百名球迷先是一愣，紧接着就发出了嘘声，原本一场热身赛，根本就没必要这么较真，但是刚才迪甘的那个失误实在是太业余了。
迪甘也是一阵懊恼，他发现场边塔索蒂的眉头皱了起来，脸上写满了失望，那表情分明就是再说：卡卡的弟弟，终究不是卡卡！
里米尼的球员显然也没预料到他们能先进米兰一球，反应过来之后，开始了疯狂的庆祝，场边的里米尼教练先是一阵欢呼，紧接着迪甘就看见一个矮胖老头在本子上记了些什么。
他们是在对自己失望吗？
迪甘愣在了原地，就连潘卡罗走过来安慰了他两句，他都没听到。

“嘿！瞧见没有，那个傻大个的失误真是太业余了。”
“他可是卡卡的弟弟，我看除了长得像，这家伙简直一无是处，我觉得他应该去十岁以下的青年队，在那里，他能找到属于自己的位置！”
“说的没错，伙计！知道这叫什么吗？他就是王子故事里面的那个小配角，真不知道两兄弟的差距怎么会这么大！”
那些球迷距离球场很近，再加上在场的人不多，那些议论准确无误的全都钻进了迪甘的耳朵里，让他的心一阵向下沉。
最让迪甘接受不了的是，博斯克也是一脸无奈的摇着头，他也失望了吗？
迪甘感觉到了愤怒，感觉到了前所未有的愤怒！
职业足球！这就是职业足球！
妈的！越是瞧不起老子，老子就越是要征服你们！
content_en:
Chapter 3 This is professional football
In the locker room, this time was used for pre-war arrangements, but the fat Ancelotti did not show up today. He is a famous coach who has won the league championship and the Champions League championship. Naturally, there is no need for his presence in such an unplanned warm-up match. As a famous coach, sometimes he has to give other people opportunities, such as his former teammate and current assistant Tassotti.
Tassotti was once one of the founders of the Milan dynasty and a meritorious general of AC Milan. He was majestic on the football field, but in the position of coach, his character destined that it was difficult for him to be alone and could only exist as a supporter. When Terim was in office, he was the assistant coach. Now it is Ancelotti's turn. He is still the assistant coach. His role has never changed. Deegan also knows that he will still have this role after Leonardo and Allegri took charge of Milan.
It must be said that Tassotti's tactical arrangements were extremely boring and made people sleepy, but Deegan still tried hard to persevere and look focused.
It was time to announce the starting lineup. The goalkeeper was Fiori, the third goalkeeper of the first team, a 35-year-old uncle who had been playing for Milan for four years. However, he had only had one opportunity in four years. However, this uncle was not an economical person. At least he was very smart. By the time he retired, he had already obtained a doctorate in law.
Deegan occupies a place among the four players in the defense, and the remaining three are left back Pancaro, an Italian veteran who played for the team last season.
Center back Deegan's partner is the Argentinian, the young lion Coloccini. After wandering for two years, he finally returned to the team. However, Deegan knew that this guy also failed to succeed in AC Milan. He only played once in half a season, and then went to Deportivo La Coruna.
Right back Croatian Simic, the indispensable soy sauce man in AC Milan, clamors for either the main position or leaving every season, but after the start of each season, people can always find his shadow on the bench.
In the midfield diamond position, behind is the old Italian boy Donati, but I heard that he has already left, and his next stop will be Messina. He is used to living a wandering life, and Donati seems to be very open-minded about all this.
The two guardians are Darabona and the Frenchman Dorasu who transferred in the new season. One is a tragic man who was cheated by AC Milan, and the other is the French king who is tired of staying at the Diaosi Club.
The person responsible for organizing the attack is AC Milan's substitute King Brocchi. This guy has never played well in AC Milan, but once he leaves Milanello and is loaned to other teams, he can always show his amazing strength. Because of this, AC Milan has always been hard to let go of him.
The two forwards are Borriello, a green hat man in Serie A, and Matri, who was produced in the Milan youth training and later became a legend in Cagliari.
Deegan really wanted to tell Tassotti that he wanted to play the center position, but he made the decision yesterday to be a good boy, and it would be a bit unreasonable to not follow the coach's tactical arrangements today.
Besides, Deegan believes that he is a genius, so what can he do as a central defender? He feels that he can also defeat the nerves of coach Rimini and get a ticket to professional football.
It's just that Tassotti's tactical arrangement made Deegan a little unhappy. He defended and counterattacked, and defensive players were not allowed to cross the center line in sports battles.
Playing against a rookie team like Rimini, defensive counterattacks were actually needed. Deegan even felt that because of Tassotti's cautious character, he should wear a safety helmet when standing on the sidelines, because no one stipulates that birds cannot lay eggs while flying.
But now Deegan can't say anything, because he has to be a good boy, because he has to show his professionalHis brother is Kaka, a well-mannered prince.
"Rhode! Is there a problem?"
Deegan was stunned. He didn't expect Tassotti to ask him specifically. In fact, he didn't listen to anything just now. Now that he was asked, he couldn't help but feel a little embarrassed: "No! Coach! No~~~~~No!"
Deegan's helpless look caused a burst of laughter in the locker room. Pancaro, as the biggest player on the starting list, laughed and said: "Rod! Calm down!"
Tassotti also smiled and said: "Rod! This is just a warm-up match, no big deal! And this is your first game representing Milan. As long as you show your strength! You can do a good job!"
Tassotti's reminder changed the way Borriello and others looked at Deegan. It was obvious that they were envious. As players who had played for Milan for many years, they had been on loan and were working hard while waiting for opportunities. However, after so many years, the god of luck never came to them. As soon as Deegan came, he received the attention of the coach. Although they all knew what was going on, they couldn't help but be envious and even jealous.
After completing the tactical arrangement, Tassotti stood aside and watched the players change their equipment. This was just a warm-up match, and no one would ask them when to play.
Deegan also got his jersey No. 82, a very unusual number. To say it is unusual is because this number is destined not to appear in the AC Milan first team in the new season.
But Deegan didn't think much of it. He was a fan of AC Milan in his previous life, and being able to wear Milan jerseys to play is a very unusual thing in itself.
When it's time to play, Deegan doesn't feel a trace of nervousness, but only excitement. In his previous life, he stayed away from his beloved football because of a heart disease. His talent can only be used to play football with a few friends to find happiness. Now a powerful Deegan is here.
The game was held in Milanello. In addition to the players' families, there were only 300 fan members who could come to watch the game. This atmosphere gave Deegan the feeling of a football game.
But Deegan didn't dare to relax. This was his opportunity. If he didn't want to have to hang out in the youth team in the new season, he had to seize it, seize it firmly, and then use his efforts to win a ticket to the professional league for himself.
Among the crowd watching the game, Deegan also discovered his parents. Of course, Caroline also came. Deegan had known Kaka since they met her. Although the two did not develop into a couple, they were very good friends.
Standing in front of the penalty area, watching the referee blow the whistle, the game started. Although it was only a second-tier team, it was obvious that Milan's strength was still not something Rimini could compete with. In the first ten minutes of the game, the football was basically in Rimini's half, and Deegan had no chance to perform.
It doesn't matter, the game is still long and he has plenty of opportunities to perform.
Perhaps God heard his prayers. Matri shot and was pinned down by Rimini's goalkeeper. Then with a big kick, he drove into Milan's half and flew directly in the direction of Deegan.
According to the way a defender strives to handle it, Deegan should find the landing point of the football, and then rely on Rimini's forward to head the ball back.
But Deegan didn't want to do this. In that case, he would have no chance to show his strength. As a winger in his previous life, his judgment of the ball's placement was undoubtedly superior to others. He jumped up slightly, stopped the ball with his chest, and then~~~~~ nothing happened.
Deegan forgot about the speed of his current body and stopped the ball a little far. As a result, Rimini's striker got the ball first and made a diagonal pass. The ball reached the left side of Milan's entry. Pancaro was distracted and another striker of the opponent took the ball.When the ball arrived, Fiori could only abandon the goal and attack. As a result, the opponent player calmly fired a low shot through the AC Milan goal.
AC Milan conceded the first goal. The three hundred fans present were stunned at first, and then booed. Originally, there was no need to be so serious in a warm-up match, but Deegan's mistake just now was too amateurish.
Deegan was also annoyed for a while. He found that Tassotti's brows were wrinkled on the sidelines, and his face was full of disappointment. That expression clearly meant: Kaka's younger brother is not Kaka after all!
The Rimini players obviously did not expect that they would score a goal ahead of Milan. After reacting, they started celebrating wildly. The Rimini coach on the sidelines cheered first, and then Deegan saw a short, fat old man writing something down in a notebook.
Are they disappointed in themselves?
Deegan was stunned on the spot. Even when Pancaro came over and comforted him, he didn't hear it.
"Hey! Did you see that that stupid guy's mistake was so amateurish?"
"He is Kaká's younger brother. I think apart from the fact that he looks similar, this guy is useless. I think he should go to the under-10 youth team, where he can find his own place!"
"That's right, man! Do you know what this is called? He is the supporting character in the prince's story. I really don't know why the gap between the two brothers is so big!"
Those fans were very close to the stadium, and there were not many people present. All the accurate comments reached Deegan's ears, making his heart sink.
What Deegan couldn't accept the most was that Bosque also shook his head helplessly. Was he disappointed too?
Deegan felt angry, felt unprecedented anger!
Professional football! This is professional football!
Oh shit! The more you look down on me, the more I will conquer you!
